confirmedFailures: Normalized UV coordinates stretch the same coarse granular appearance once across every slab and create repeated stair glints.
Wet stone reads as blue edged concrete rather than worn polygon granite with localized wet patches.
Repeated long straight framing branches end in flattened leaf clusters and do not cast the required near path shadows.
Window lintel gaps expose the background sky through the facade.
Entrance decoration is mostly evenly sized linework; it lacks sculptural depth and a hierarchy of carved timber and applied gilt.
The lantern has an overly long plain shaft, thin cap, weak carving and simplified finial proportions.

thirdPass.paving: Shared perturbed grid nodes define individual closed polygon slabs; bevels are six millimetres, not rounded pillow shoulders.
thirdPass.wetness: World position based metre scale wet roughness patches; no repeated wet patch per normalized slab.
thirdPass.trees: Curved tapered forks carry real volumetric leaf clusters. A right near camera crown physically casts directional shadows into the foreground.
thirdPass.lantern: New carved short shaft, broad stepped base, solid ornament frieze, recessed window cavity, thick closed curved cap and surface rooted moss.
thirdPass.entrance: Three sculpted beams with wood relief behind selective raised gilt leaves at different scales; solid wood infill closes facade gaps.
thirdPass.contactOcclusion: 25 cm GTAO contact radius. Alpha pine cards and transparent water are excluded from the geometry depth pass.
thirdPass.status: CPU checked; actual third GPU image pending. No visual acceptance asserted.
